body:
Performance regression results for #9703 (TMA descriptor load + BF16-to-FP32 max reduction over the middle axis)

Change: Coalesce compares the default vectorized layout with a narrower candidate for a single-use NVIDIA `tt.descriptor_load` feeding a non-innermost reduction. It chooses the candidate only when the reduction fanout falls; otherwise it keeps the default. Descriptor gathers keep their default layout.

Method: input BF16 `[1, 8192, 8192]`, TMA tile `[1, BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N]`, FP32 output, `torch` 2.8.0+cu128, same repository PTXAS per GPU. Each value is the median of 7 `triton.testing.do_bench_cudagraph(rep=10)` measurements in microseconds. Every result below passed the PyTorch correctness check. H100 results were measured on `NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3` (SM 9.0). B300 results report `NVIDIA B300 SXM6 AC` (SM 10.3). Baseline is upstream commit `4fd7cc5cf`. The full matrices below were measured with the initial fix at `77450ef5c`/`46b50b167`; focused results for the refined rule at `98b41d3e8` follow the tables.

| GPU | warps | tile | Triton 3.5.1 | Triton 3.6.0 | upstream 3.9.0 | patched 3.9.0 | patched vs upstream |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H100 | 8 | 32×32 | 86.80 | 191.26 | 109.50 | 80.95 | -26.1% |
| H100 | 8 | 32×64 | 53.90 | 182.09 | 104.67 | 53.99 | -48.4% |
| H100 | 8 | 128×64 | 47.65 | 54.20 | 49.26 | 47.64 | -3.3% |
| H100 | 8 | 32×128 | 48.56 | 163.04 | 56.15 | 48.58 | -13.5% |
| H100 | 8 | 32×256 | 49.02 | 156.34 | 50.34 | 49.00 | -2.7% |
| H100 | 8 | 32×512 | 49.96 | 82.44 | 50.34 | 49.33 | -2.0% |
| H100 | 8 | 32×1024 | 50.11 | 51.51 | 49.81 | 49.48 | -0.6% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×32 | 80.05 | 166.71 | 84.92 | 72.56 | -14.6% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×64 | 41.75 | 159.47 | 75.16 | 41.08 | -45.3% |
| B300 | 8 | 128×64 | 23.11 | 46.47 | 28.69 | 22.90 | -20.2% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×128 | 26.63 | 143.52 | 37.50 | 27.29 | -27.2% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×256 | 22.84 | 136.81 | 28.67 | 22.87 | -20.2% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×512 | 23.47 | 72.01 | 23.99 | 22.68 | -5.5% |
| B300 | 8 | 32×1024 | 23.74 | 28.84 | 23.51 | 22.89 | -2.6% |

Representative 4-warp results from the same benchmark setup:

| GPU | warps | tile | Triton 3.5.1 | Triton 3.6.0 | upstream 3.9.0 | patched 3.9.0 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H100 | 4 | 32×64 | 48.40 | 99.91 | 51.96 | 48.52 |
| H100 | 4 | 32×128 | 48.57 | 88.65 | 50.12 | 48.34 |
| B300 | 4 | 32×64 | 25.58 | 86.84 | 43.83 | 25.68 |
| B300 | 4 | 32×128 | 22.61 | 77.67 | 29.44 | 22.51 |

Focused recheck after the fanout guard (`98b41d3e8`), in µs:

| GPU | warps | tile | patched 3.9.0 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| H100 | 4 | 32×64 | 48.43 |
| H100 | 4 | 32×128 | 48.82 |
| H100 | 8 | 32×64 | 53.92 |
| H100 | 8 | 32×128 | 48.53 |
| B300 | 4 | 32×64 | 25.58 |
| B300 | 4 | 32×128 | 22.51 |
| B300 | 8 | 32×64 | 41.16 |
| B300 | 8 | 32×128 | 27.29 |

All 8 focused results passed correctness checks and retained the expected layouts.

The 8-warp matrix contains 56/56 correct version/tile/GPU results. No tested 8-warp case showed a performance regression against upstream. Differences below roughly 2% should be treated as measurement-level changes. The layout test now covers an 8-warp narrow tile (`32×64`) and the `32×512` vector-width boundary.

## Follow-up: sub-warp width gate removed (`f9a610f29`)

The previous patch returned the default descriptor-load layout when the
contiguous tile width was below 32, even when the candidate reduced reduction
fanout. The updated patch uses the existing strict fanout comparison for these
widths as well. The existing width-32-and-above tables remain applicable.

These are paired measurements of the guarded patch versus the updated patch,
using the same `[1,8192,8192]` input and correctness check described above.
Each value below is the median of two independent seven-sample CUDA graph
medians, in µs. Lower is better.

| GPU | dtype | warps | tile | with width gate | without width gate | PTX shuffles |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H100 | BF16 | 4 | 32×8 | 160.08 | 159.69 | 12 → 4 |
| H100 | BF16 | 4 | 32×16 | 98.53 | 81.87 | 20 → 3 |
| H100 | BF16 | 8 | 32×16 | 181.70 | 148.64 | 12 → 4 |
| H100 | BF16 | 8 | 64×16 | 100.36 | 84.97 | 24 → 4 |
| B300 | BF16 | 4 | 32×16 | 87.65 | 71.99 | 20 → 3 |
| B300 | BF16 | 4 | 64×8 | 79.01 | 72.88 | 8 → 4 |
| B300 | BF16 | 4 | 64×16 | 56.78 | 40.54 | 16 → 3 |
| H100 | FP32 | 4 | 32×16 | 109.65 | 99.80 | 20 → 3 |
| H100 | FP32 | 4 | 64×16 | 91.76 | 91.51 | 20 → 3 |

For BF16 `32×16` on H100, fanout falls from 32 to 8. PTX changes from one
`ld.shared.v4.b16` to four scalar `ld.shared.b16` loads, but the shuffle count
falls from 20 to 3 and the end-to-end time improves. Width-32 controls keep
the same layout and approximately the same performance. The updated branch
passed the Coalesce lit test, pre-commit checks, and an H100 correctness smoke
check (81.80 µs for BF16 `32×16`, 4 warps).
